text:
Alex Chen: Quick poll — prefer Fri-Sat for the annual strategy weekend at SF HQ. Need travel + room holds by EOW.
Priya Rao: Fri-Sat works for product. Can we do a half-day Friday so remote folks can join asynchronously?
Jordan Li: +1 to half-day. Also need to lock facilitators for each theme: Cost, Reliability, GTM, Roadmap.
Mei Park: I can facilitate Reliability. Carlos will lead Cost. @Tessa can you take GTM?
Tessa Nguyen: Yep I can do GTM. We should define 30/45/60 min slots with breakout templates.
Alex Chen: Draft run-of-show in docs: https://redwood.docs/annual/weekend/draft — pls review. Prework: 1-pager with top-3 metrics + 1 trade-off question.
Carlos Martinez: AV note — HQ main room has 2 mics + projector. Need backup laptop + wired network. @facilities any chance to reserve spare laptop?
facilities: Reserving spare laptop and wired drop for main room. Will confirm by Thu.
ops-bot: Event booking confirmed: Main Conf A reserved Fri 12:00-18:00 Sat 09:00-17:00. Catering held tentatively.
Samir Khan: Hybrid: we should have a dedicated remote facilitator to manage chat and T.O. for each session. Suggest rotation.
Priya Rao: Agreed. @Jordan can you create a rotation table? We need to call on remote participants at least twice per session.
Jordan Li: Will do. Table and session threads in doc.
Mei Park: Facilitation cheat-sheet: check-in (5), lightning updates (10), divergence (20), converge + outcomes (15), assign owners (5).
Alex Chen: For scope negotiation: can't deep-dive infra perf, pricing, and model gating all in one breakout. Propose pricing be a policy session; defer detailed modeling to post-offsite sprint.
Carlos Martinez: Proposal accepted: deep-dive infra perf (ops+infra) during offsite; detailed pricing modeling async after. Use canary customers as case studies.
Tessa Nguyen: Launch criteria workshop — use a must-have / nice-to-have / blocked-unless matrix. Aim for 3 demoable outcomes per practice area.
Samir Khan: Ops, can you provide a simple latency/cost dashboard snapshot for Friday? Need numbers for discussion.
ops-bot: Snapshot exported: s3://redwood-event/latency-cost-snapshot-1891234567.csv
Alex Chen: Action items: Jordan — facilitator rotation + session threads by Thu. Priya — prework template + send invites by Wed. facilities — AV confirm by Thu. All — RSVP by Wed COB.
Tessa Nguyen: Recording policy: record core sessions but ask permission during intros. Upload recordings to internal GDrive.
Mei Park: Emergency fallbacks if projector fails: (1) HDMI dongle + spare laptop, (2) whiteboard + printed slides.
Carlos Martinez: I'll bring 2 HDMI dongles and the spare laptop. Packing checklist added to doc.
Alex Chen: If no objections I'll confirm Friday by EOD. :thumbsup:
Jordan Li: :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: :heart:
